advanced.restoreOutputDesc: Restore previous terminal output on restart
advanced.restoreOutputEnable: Show previous session output above new shell

defaults.description: These settings apply to all new profiles. Individual profiles can override them.

paste.title: Paste
paste.smartPasteDesc: On Ctrl+V, paste clipboard files/images as paths
paste.imageDirDesc: Image save path (leave empty to use the default directory)
paste.smartRemoveLineBreakDesc: Restore URLs broken by line breaks when pasting
paste.smartLinkJoinDesc: Detect indented multi-line URLs as a single clickable link
paste.multiFileSeparatorDesc: Separator between paths when pasting multiple files
paste.quotePathsDesc: Wrap each pasted file path in double quotes (useful for paths with spaces)
paste.largeWarningDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when pasting large text

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.defaultInputModeDesc: Input mode a new terminal starts in. Switch anytime with Ctrl+Alt+M or the pane toolbar button.
terminal.advertiseTrueColorDesc: Tell CLI programs that new terminals support truecolor. Turn this off to compare compatibility or rendering performance; it applies to newly created terminals.
terminal.composerHistoryScopeDesc: How widely the Composer's past-input list is shared. The list itself stays in memory only and is gone after a reload.
terminal.composerHistoryPopupDesc: In Composer mode, press Tab in an empty focused input to list your recent inputs and pick one.
terminal.composerAutocompleteDesc: In Composer mode, suggest matching past inputs as you type; press Tab (or arrow keys then Enter) to fill one in.
terminal.composerStarredEntriesDesc: Permanent inputs shared by every workspace and Remote on this host.
terminal.composerStarredEntrySendDesc: Selecting this suggestion also submits it.
terminal.copyOnSelectDesc: Automatically copy to clipboard when selecting text in the terminal
terminal.pathLinkDesc: Underline a selected file/folder path; click to open the file in the viewer or change the directory.
terminal.pathLinkMaxLengthDesc: Candidates longer than this (characters) are not treated as paths.
terminal.pathLinkOsOpenDesc: Ctrl+click an underlined path to open it on this PC (file association, or the file manager for folders); Ctrl+Shift+click shows it in the file manager. WSL paths open on this PC too.
terminal.pathLinkOsOpenConfirm: Always confirm before opening in the OS
terminal.pathLinkOsOpenConfirmDesc: Ask every time a file is opened with its associated app. When off, only risky extensions (executables, scripts) still ask. Showing a location and opening a folder never ask. Applies to the file viewer buttons as well, not just Ctrl+click.
terminal.urlLinkActivationDesc: What a click or tap on a URL does. "Show an action chip" opens nothing on the click; a small chip appears next to the link and only its button opens the browser or copies the URL. Shift/Alt+click inside a full-screen app still opens right away.
terminal.pathLinkActivationDesc: What a click or tap on an underlined path does. "Show an action chip" opens nothing on the click; the chip offers the viewer (or changing the directory), opening in the OS, and copying the path. Ctrl / Ctrl+Shift+click still goes straight to the OS in both modes.
terminal.scrollSensitivityDesc: Multiplier for how far one mouse wheel notch scrolls. 1 is the default; higher scrolls further (0.1-20). The Remote surface has its own value in Remote settings.
terminal.fastScrollSensitivityDesc: Multiplier used while Alt is held down. Default 5 (0.1-20).
terminal.scrollToBottomButtonDesc: Show the floating button that jumps to the bottom when scrolled up into the scrollback.
terminal.interruptOnExitDesc: When quitting the app, send Ctrl+C to every terminal to wind down running work (cron, etc.) and nudge Claude Code / Codex to print their resume session id into the scrollback.
terminal.interruptRoundsDesc: How many times to send Ctrl+C to each terminal (1–10). Claude / Codex usually need at least 2.
terminal.interruptSettleDesc: How long to wait after the last Ctrl+C before closing the window, so the session id can print into the scrollback (0–10000).
terminal.paneClearGroupDesc: Alt+L actually clears the focused terminal pane. Shells receive the command below; Claude Code, Codex, and Grok receive /clear. Unknown interactive apps are left untouched.
terminal.paneClearShellCommandDesc: Submitted to a plain shell. Use cls for cmd.exe.
terminal.paneClearBusyPolicyDesc: Choose what Alt+L does while work is running. Restart creates a fresh terminal session and discards scrollback; interrupt sends Ctrl+C first.
terminal.paneClearInterruptRoundsDesc: How many times to send Ctrl+C before clearing (1–10).
terminal.paneClearSettleDesc: How long to wait after the last Ctrl+C before submitting the clear input (0–10000).

interface.title: Interface
interface.hoverAutoHideDesc: Delay before hiding the control bar when the mouse is idle (0 = never hide)
interface.controlBarModeDesc: Default control bar mode for new panes
interface.dockPersistDesc: Keep dock state in the background even when hidden (terminal processes keep running)
interface.dockArrowNavDesc: Allow entering/leaving the dock area with Alt+Arrow
interface.dockArrowFocusPaneDesc: Auto-move focus from the dock to a pane when switching workspaces with arrows
interface.notificationDismissDesc: When notifications are marked as read
interface.dismissManual: Dismiss only by clicking the notification
interface.keepAwakeDesc: Keep the machine from sleeping. Same switch as the top-bar button. The display still turns off as usual.
interface.keepAwakeWhenBusyDesc: Keep the machine from sleeping while any terminal is running. It sleeps as usual once they all finish.

remote.title: Remote
remote.enabledDesc: Open Direct Remote Mode automatically on the next app start. A token is generated when this is enabled without one.
remote.tailscaleOnlyDesc: Allow Direct Remote requests only from Tailscale address ranges. Cloud tunnel requests are unaffected, and the existing IP allowlist and token checks still apply.
remote.allowedIpsDesc: IP/CIDR allowlist for browser remote clients.
remote.autoMobileMinWidthDesc: 0 disables. Remote Access opens automatically when the app window is at or below this width, or when a phone (portrait screen with its short edge at or below this value) connects over RDP.
remote.serveTerminalFontDesc: Send the desktop terminal font file to remote browsers so they render the same glyphs and cell widths. Serving a font binary over the network is redistribution, so enable it only for fonts you may redistribute (OS-bundled fonts such as Consolas are not). The font is downloaded once per browser.
remote.widgetsDesc: Mirror the widgets you placed on the desktop onto a single row at the top of the remote client. Placement and options stay in Interface → Widgets; turning this off only drops the remote row and keeps your placement.
remote.customHostsDesc: Host names or IPs to offer in the Remote Access copy URL selector.
remote.attachmentMaxMibDesc: Largest file a Remote client may attach, 1–10 MiB. Built-in types are images, UTF-8 text, PDF, DOCX and PPTX. Requests through the Cloud relay are also capped by the relay payload limit; the page shows the effective limit and suggests connecting over Tailscale when the relay binds.
remote.attachmentAllowAllExtensionsDesc: Accept every file type as an opaque binary attachment. Files are stored under the app cache with their sanitized extension and never opened by the host.
remote.attachmentExtraExtensionsDesc: Additional extensions accepted as opaque binary attachments, e.g. xlsx or zip. Letters and digits only, no dot.
remote.preferredHostDesc: Host preselected in Remote Access URLs. Automatic uses the last selected host, then the first available candidate.
remote.cloudAccessModeDesc: Cloud login and PC registration remain available. Android E2E only blocks ordinary Cloud browser relay Remote at this PC; Local and Tailscale Direct access are unchanged.
remote.cloudRelayBaseUrlDesc: Relay URL used for cloud pairing. Leave the product default unless you are using a development relay.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.lastInputModeDesc: Show the last submitted input per pane or one latest line per workspace
workspaces.confirmDestructiveActionsDesc: Require two clicks for workspace hide, terminal clear, layout delete, and workspace close
workspaces.pathEllipsisDesc: Truncation direction for long paths (workspace list)
workspaces.hiddenAutoCloseDesc: Auto-close terminals of hidden workspaces/panes to save resources (0 = never close). A new terminal is created when shown again.
workspaces.cwdWorkspaceDesc: Default for terminal panes inside workspaces
workspaces.cwdDockDesc: Default for terminal panes inside dock areas

claude.title: Claude Code
claude.syncCwdDesc: How cd is propagated to terminals running Claude Code
claude.commandDesc: Command used to start Claude Code, flags included
claude.commandInvalid: Only an executable name/path and flags are allowed — shell metacharacters (; & | $ ` " ' < >) and line breaks are rejected. "{{command}}" is used instead.
claude.restoreSessionDesc: Automatically restore Claude Code sessions on app restart
claude.sessionMaxAgeDesc: Ignore session files older than this (0 = unlimited)
claude.statusMessageModeDesc: Status source shown in the workspace list
claude.delimiterDesc: Separator text between the two sources
claude.autoResumeDesc: Automatically send a resume message once the session limit reset time has passed
claude.resumeDelayDesc: Wait this long after the limit reset time before sending
claude.resumeMessageDesc: Message to send to Claude Code after the limit resets

codex.title: Codex
codex.commandDesc: Command used to start the Codex CLI, flags included
codex.commandInvalid: Only an executable name/path and flags are allowed — shell metacharacters (; & | $ ` " ' < >) and line breaks are rejected. "{{command}}" is used instead.
codex.restoreSessionDesc: Automatically restore Codex sessions on app restart
codex.sessionMaxAgeDesc: Ignore rollouts older than this (0 = unlimited)
codex.transcriptScrollDesc: Use mouse-wheel and Remote touch scrolling as arrow-key navigation in a normal-buffer transcript
codex.statusMessageModeDesc: How Codex status text is shown in the workspace list
codex.delimiterDesc: Separator string between the two texts

grok.title: Grok Build
grok.commandInvalid: Only an executable name/path and flags are allowed — shell metacharacters (; & | $ ` " ' < >) and line breaks are rejected. "{{command}}" is used instead.
grok.delimiterDesc: Separator text between the two sources

fileExplorer.title: File Explorer
fileExplorer.shellProfileDesc: Shell profile used for CWD sync. Uses the default profile if empty.
fileExplorer.fontFamilyDesc: Font for the file list area. Inherits the default font if empty.
fileExplorer.fontSizeDesc: Font size for the file list area (px). Default: 13
fileExplorer.paddingDesc: Inner padding of the file list area (px)
fileExplorer.copyOnSelectDesc: Automatically copy the path to the clipboard when selecting a file.
fileExplorer.extensionViewersDesc: Open files with a shell program and terminal profile per extension
fileExplorer.viewerProfileMissing: Selected terminal profile does not exist.

viewer.title: File Viewer
viewer.fontFamilyDesc: Font for opened file content. Inherits the default font if empty.
viewer.fontSizeDesc: Font size for opened file content (px). Default: 13. Also adjustable with Ctrl+Scroll inside the viewer.
viewer.paddingDesc: Inner padding of the opened file content area (px)

issueReporter.title: Issue Reporter
issueReporter.shellDesc: Shell prefix to run the gh CLI. Runs gh directly if empty. Quotes supported.
issueReporter.repositoriesDesc: Repos to file issues to (owner/repo). The first item is selected by default.
issueReporter.paddingDesc: Inner padding of the issue reporter area (px)

github.title: GitHub
github.defaultTabDesc: Tab a pane opens on until you pick one there. A pane keeps the tab you picked.
github.refreshSecondsDesc: Seconds between issue/PR list polls. Below 10s just re-reads the server's own cache.
github.hideDraftPullsDesc: Exclude draft pull requests from the PRs tab's list and count.
github.fontFamilyDesc: Typeface used for the list rows.
github.fontSizeDesc: Size of the number and title in px. Author, age, and labels follow 2px smaller.
github.showAuthorDesc: Show the author on the right of each row.
github.showUpdatedDesc: Show how long ago the item was updated.
github.showDraftBadgeDesc: Mark draft pull requests with a DRAFT badge. With "Hide draft PRs" on there is no such row to mark.
github.labelMaxCountDesc: How many labels one row may show. 0 hides labels entirely.
github.labelMaxWidthDesc: Widest a single label chip may get, in px. Longer names are ellipsized.

memo.title: Memo
memo.paddingDesc: Inner padding of the memo area (px)
memo.indentSizeDesc: Number of spaces inserted by the Tab key
memo.paragraphDetectionDesc: Separate paragraphs by N or more blank lines (used for triple-click paragraph select)
memo.tripleClickSelectDesc: Select the whole paragraph on triple-click
memo.copyOnSelectDesc: Automatically copy to clipboard when drag-selecting text

recovery.parseErrorTitle: Could not read the settings file
recovery.parseErrorDescription: The JSON syntax in settings.json is invalid, so starting with default settings.
recovery.recoveredTitle: Some setting values could not be read
recovery.recoveredDescription: The items below had the wrong value type, so they were dropped and started from their defaults. Every other setting was kept.
recovery.recoveredWriteBlocked: Nothing is written to settings.json until you confirm. To keep the original values, edit the file directly and restart the app.
recovery.droppedCount: {{num}} item(s) were dropped and replaced with defaults.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.intro: Choose what sits in the top bar and the status line. A slot's order is the on-screen order, and left or right is decided by which slot you place it in. The top bar reserves its window drag region first; when the remaining width runs out, the widgets farthest from the window edge collapse first.
widgets.statusLineEnabledDesc: Adds one widget row at the very bottom of the window, below every dock. Turning it off keeps the placement.
widgets.activityBusyWorkspace: {{busy}} of {{total}} terminals busy in this workspace
widgets.activityBusyAll: {{busy}} of {{total}} terminals busy across all workspaces
widgets.selectHint: Pick a widget to edit its settings here.

usage.title: Usage Monitor
usage.intro: Reads Claude Code's /usage panel in a hidden session and shows it in a UsageView pane. The query process only runs while at least one UsageView pane is open.
usage.profileDesc: Profile of the shell that has claude installed
usage.refreshDesc: Seconds. Rate limits pin this to 600-3600
usage.codexProfileDesc: Terminal font profile used by Codex UsageView
usage.codexRefreshDesc: Seconds between local Codex account reads. Clamped to 600-3600
usage.grokProfileDesc: Profile of the shell that has grok installed
usage.grokRefreshDesc: Seconds. Process cost pins this to 600-3600
usage.grokConfigDirsDesc: GROK_HOME directories to monitor alongside the default, which is always included
usage.visibleRowsDesc: Limits shown in every UsageView. Keep at least one selected
usage.codexAccountDirsDesc: CODEX_HOME directories separately signed in with codex login
usage.colorUsedDesc: Consumed usage fill shared by Claude and Codex
usage.colorPaceDesc: Elapsed window fill and percentage shared by Claude and Codex
usage.colorTrackDesc: Unfilled meter track shared by Claude and Codex
usage.configDirsDesc: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR paths to monitor alongside the default, which is always included

update.title: Updates
update.channelDesc: Which releases this machine follows. Saving checks right away.
update.channelBetaWarning: Beta builds are not guaranteed to be stable. Switching back to Stable brings no update until a stable release passes your installed version.
update.checkNowDesc: The app also checks on startup and every 6 hours.
update.busy: An update operation is already running.
update.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
update.disabledInDev: Self-update is disabled in development builds.

hiddenItems.hideAndMove: Hide and move to the next workspace
